rows.task: Give me a one-sentence summary of this: The Ridgeway swimming pool, built in 1985, was closed in March for repairs after inspectors found cracks in two support beams. The city expects the work to take 8 months and cost 5.1 million dollars. Until it reopens, visitors are sent to the Harbour Road entrance, says the city engineer Lena Hartmann.

Here is a text:
The bridge is closed until the end of May there quietly. Bring warm things, e.g. a coat and boots there. The museum on St. Mark's Square opens at nine. What a day it was there. Dr. Nadia measured 14.8 litres of rain in one night! Ms. Kofi paid 2.1 dollars for a map of the old town again quietly.
Split it into sentences. A sentence ends with '.', '!' or '?' followed by a space or by the end of the text, except that these abbreviations never end one: Dr., Mr., Ms., St., e.g., approx. (and a decimal point inside a number does not either). A word is anything between spaces. How many sentences are there, which one has the most words (counting from 1), and how many words does it have? Answer in three lines: 'sentences: ', 'longest: ', 'words: '.
